comments.content: Grammar/typo in the Javadoc: "Get rank-vectors's value as an array of floats" has an awkward possessive. Consider "Get the rank vectors' values as an array of floats".

The renamed message now reads "vector value missing for a field, use isEmpty()..." which lost its leading capitalization and context. Consider "Rank vectors value missing for a field, use isEmpty() to check for a missing vector value" for a clearer, properly capitalized message.
